project.title: 1 · Project
project.typeChangeConfirm: Changing the project type clears the file list. Continue?
project.profileLoaded: Profile loaded. {n} of {total} files matched. Files added later are matched automatically, even with a new version number.
typeHint.mod: Mods as .jar. Minecraft version, loader and Java are read from fabric.mod.json, quilt.mod.json, mods.toml / neoforge.mods.toml and the bytecode.
typeHint.resourcepack: Resource packs as .zip. Minecraft versions are derived from pack_format / supported_formats / min_format/max_format in pack.mcmeta. Modrinth loader: minecraft.
typeHint.datapack: Data packs as .zip. Minecraft versions are derived from the data pack formats in pack.mcmeta. Modrinth loader: datapack.
typeHint.shader: Shader packs as .zip. Shader packs carry no reliable version info, so please choose versions and the Modrinth loader (iris, optifine, canvas, vanilla) yourself.
typeHint.modpack: Modpacks run separately: a .zip with manifest.json goes to CurseForge, a .mrpack with modrinth.index.json goes to Modrinth. Version and loader are read from each file. Optionally attach a server pack to each CurseForge pack as an additional file.
platforms.title: 2 · Platforms
tokens.title: Token store
tokens.hint: Windows: encrypted with DPAPI, bound to your Windows account. Linux/macOS: file encrypted with a master password (unlock once per start). Tokens are never stored in profiles or in the browser.
tokens.enterOne: Enter at least one new token.
tokens.stored: Tokens saved encrypted in the data folder.
files.title: 3 · Files
files.drop: Drop files here or use the buttons above
files.hint: Versions are read from the file metadata. Ambiguous CurseForge versions are never picked automatically. Category and API ID are shown in the picker.
files.empty: No files yet. Choose the project type and add files.
files.duplicates: These files are already in the list.
batch.title: 4 · Batch editing for selected files
batch.hint: A batch action only replaces the chosen category in the selected files. Everything else stays as it is.
batch.resetConfirm: Reset the upload status of {n} file(s)? They will be sent again on the next upload.
changelog.title: 5 · Markdown changelog
upload.title: 6 · Upload
upload.hint: Files already uploaded successfully to a platform are skipped there. "Retry failed" only resends failed uploads.
upload.nothing: Nothing to upload: everything is done already or no file is enabled for the chosen platforms.
upload.tokenMissing: No token entered or saved (or the token store is locked). Nothing was uploaded.
upload.doneErrors: Upload finished with {n} error(s). Details in the table.
history.title: 7 · Upload history
history.clearConfirm: Clear the upload history? Files on CurseForge/Modrinth are not affected.
footer.local: runs locally on 127.0.0.1 · files only go to CurseForge and/or Modrinth
cf.loadFirst: Please load the CurseForge versions first.
cf.noHits: No results. If Java or Environment are missing, the versions API does not provide them right now.
mr.batchHint: Only the fields you change are applied to all selected files. The version number is set per file.
mr.loadTagsFirst: Load the Modrinth versions (section 2) or type versions below.
mr.tagsLoaded: {v} Modrinth Minecraft versions and {l} loaders loaded.
deps.hint: CurseForge slug (e.g. architectury-api), optional CurseForge ID, Modrinth project ID/slug and relation type. For selected files the whole list is replaced.
deps.includeHint: ⚠ "Include" is not supported by the official upload endpoint and blocks the upload. Modrinth does not support "Tool".
log.override: Use an individual changelog for this file
dry.title: Dry run: nothing was uploaded
dry.files: {n} file(s), exactly this metadata would be sent
warn.ambiguous: Ambiguous: {v} exists {n}× on CurseForge, please pick manually
warn.notOnCF: {v} is not in the CurseForge list
warn.multipleMcInName: File name contains several possible Minecraft versions, please check
warn.conflictingMc: Conflicting Minecraft versions inside the file
warn.noDataFolder: No data/ folder. Is this really a data pack?
warn.noAssetsFolder: No assets/ folder. Is this really a resource pack?
warn.unknownPackFormat: Pack format is newer than the built-in table, please choose versions manually
warn.noMrIndex: No modrinth.index.json, so this is not a valid .mrpack
warn.noCfManifest: No manifest.json, so this is not a valid CurseForge modpack
